```{=html}
<div class="term">
<div class="term-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>mjfrigaard@blog: ~</em></div>
<div class="term-body">
<p><span class="prompt">$</span> <span id="whoami-cmd"></span><span class="cursor" id="whoami-cursor"></span></p>
<div id="whoami-out">
<p>Hi! I'm <span class="name">Martin Frigaard</span>.</p>
<p>I'm a Senior Application Developer at BioMarin Pharmaceutical. I like to develop Shiny applications, R packages, data visualizations and Linux admin tools.</p>
<p>This is my blog where I write about projects I'm currently working on (or topics I'm thinking about). Thanks for visiting!</p>
<p><span class="prompt">$</span> <span class="cursor"></span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const cursor = document.getElementById("whoami-cursor");
  const cmd = document.getElementById("whoami-cmd");
  if (matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
    cmd.textContent = "whoami";
    cursor.remove();
    return;
  }
  const lines = [...document.querySelectorAll("#whoami-out > p")];
  const last = lines.pop();
  last.querySelector(".cursor").remove();
  last.hidden = true;
  const queue = [{ node: cmd.appendChild(document.createTextNode("")), text: "whoami", speed: 180 }];
  for (const p of lines) {
    const w = document.createTreeWalker(p, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    const nodes = [];
    while (w.nextNode()) nodes.push(w.currentNode);
    nodes.forEach((node, k) => {
      queue.push({ node, text: node.textContent, speed: 40, line: k === 0 ? p : null });
      node.textContent = "";
    });
    p.hidden = true;
  }
  let q = 0, i = 0;
  function tick() {
    if (q === queue.length) { last.hidden = false; last.append(cursor); return; }
    const item = queue[q];
    if (i === 0) {
      if (item.line) item.line.hidden = false;
      item.node.after(cursor);
    }
    item.node.textContent = item.text.slice(0, ++i);
    if (i >= item.text.length) {
      q++; i = 0;
      const next = queue[q];
      return setTimeout(tick, !next || next.line ? 700 : item.speed);
    }
    setTimeout(tick, item.speed);
  }
  setTimeout(tick, 600);
})();
</script>
```
